```{r setup-chunk}

# load libraries
library(lubridate)
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(highcharter)
library(tidyr)
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(janitor)
library(shinyWidgets)
library(shiny)
library(EpiEstim)
library(shinyjs)
library(deSolve)

options(scipen = 999) # avoid scientific notations

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# cross-platform setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# extrafont/sysfonts are Windows-oriented and are not installed on most Linux,
# macOS or shinyapps.io images, so they are loaded only when actually present
# and any failure is swallowed. The dashboard never depends on them: all text
# is rendered by the browser from APP_FONT below.
for (fp in c("extrafont", "extrafontdb", "sysfonts", "systemfonts")) {
  if (requireNamespace(fp, quietly = TRUE)) suppressWarnings(try(
    library(fp, character.only = TRUE), silent = TRUE))
}
if (requireNamespace("extrafont", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressWarnings(try(extrafont::loadfonts(quiet = TRUE), silent = TRUE))
}

# single font stack used by every chart. The first entries are the house fonts
# (present on the authors' Windows machines); the rest are the fallbacks that
# browsers on Ubuntu, macOS, Positron and shinyapps.io will actually find.
APP_FONT <- "Tw Cen MT, Century Gothic, Questrial, Trebuchet MS, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# where the bundled assets live
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# one_logo.png, the user manual and the mock data used to be opened by bare
# relative path, which resolves against the process working directory. That is
# the app folder under RStudio's Run Document and on shinyapps.io, so it works
# there - but not when the dashboard is started from somewhere else, which is
# what `Rscript -e rmarkdown::run("/path/to/app.Rmd")` and some Positron / VS
# Code launch configurations do. The logo then renders blank and both download
# buttons return HTTP 404.
#
# app_file() tries, in order:
#   1. a copy cached at knit time (see below),
#   2. the directories knitr knows about,
#   3. the working directory - i.e. exactly the old behaviour,
# and only then gives up. It is therefore never worse than before.
#
# The knit-time cache exists because this file's name contains spaces.
# rmarkdown copies such a file into a temporary directory and knits it there,
# bringing along the resources it can detect by itself - which is not all of
# them; on this app it brings the PDF and the CSV but not the PNG. Whatever it
# does bring is reachable while this chunk runs and gone by the time
# renderImage() and the download handlers need it, so we take a durable copy
# now.
#
# If you launch the dashboard from outside its own folder, use run_seirify.R
# (it sets the working directory first). Renaming this file to something
# without spaces would also remove the temp-copy step entirely.
APP_ASSET_NAMES <- c("one_logo.png", "SEIRify_User_Manual.pdf", "mock_data-2025-06-13.csv")

APP_KNIT_DIRS <- local({
  safe <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) NULL)
  d <- unlist(c(safe(getwd()),
                safe(knitr::opts_knit$get("output.dir")),
                safe(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)))))
  d <- d[!is.na(d) & nzchar(d)]
  unique(d[dir.exists(d)])
})

APP_ASSETS <- local({
  cache <- file.path(tempdir(), "seirify-assets")
  dir.create(cache, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  found <- list()                      # a list, so a missing name gives NULL
  for (f in APP_ASSET_NAMES) {
    dest <- file.path(cache, f)
    if (!file.exists(dest)) {
      for (d in APP_KNIT_DIRS) {
        src <- file.path(d, f)
        if (file.exists(src)) { try(file.copy(src, dest, overwrite = TRUE), silent = TRUE); break }
      }
    }
    if (file.exists(dest)) found[[f]] <- dest
  }
  found
})

app_file <- function(name) {
  hit <- APP_ASSETS[[name]]
  if (!is.null(hit) && file.exists(hit)) return(hit)
  for (d in unique(c(getwd(), APP_KNIT_DIRS))) {
    p <- file.path(d, name)
    if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  }
  name                                  # old behaviour: plain relative path
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# reactive state (defined once; do not redeclare these in later chunks)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
model_results     <- reactiveVal(NULL)   # data.frame returned by the active model
current_model     <- reactiveVal(NULL)   # "SI" / "SIR" / "SEIR" at the last run
simulation_only   <- reactiveVal(TRUE)   # TRUE = simulated-only module
separate_plots    <- reactiveVal(FALSE)  # TRUE = one compartment per chart
run_clicked       <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
params_changed    <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
previous_mode     <- reactiveVal(NULL)
dataset           <- reactiveVal(NULL)
# everything a run needs to be reproduced: N, initial conditions, parameters,
# window. The confidence bands and the comparison table are derived from it,
# so they can be refreshed without re-running the model.
run_context       <- reactiveVal(NULL)

# number of parameter draws behind every confidence band and comparison CI
CI_N_DRAWS <- 200

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || all(is.na(a))) b else a

# date parsing function
parse_date <- function(x, formats = c("%d/%m/%Y", "%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%d-%m-%Y", "%Y/%m/%d")) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  best <- NULL
  best_n <- -1L
  for (fmt in formats) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(x, format = fmt))
    n_ok <- sum(!is.na(parsed))
    if (n_ok > best_n) { best_n <- n_ok; best <- parsed }
    if (all(is.na(x) | !is.na(parsed))) return(parsed)   # perfect match, stop early
  }
  # no format parses every value: keep the best one and let the caller report
  # how many rows were dropped instead of aborting the whole upload.
  best
}

# switched to data.table::fread for faster reading and processing
observeEvent(input$file1, {
  req(input$file1)

  tryCatch({
    df <- fread(input$file1$datapath) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(across(everything(), ~ if (is.character(.x)) trimws(.x) else .x)) %>%
      clean_names()

    if (!"date_of_onset" %in% names(df)) {
      showNotification(
        "The uploaded file has no 'date_of_onset' column. Required columns: date_of_onset and (for SI/SEIR) date_of_exposure.",
        type = "error", duration = 15)
      dataset(NULL)
      return()
    }

    n_in <- nrow(df)
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        date_of_exposure = if ("date_of_exposure" %in% names(df)) parse_date(date_of_exposure) else as.Date(NA),
        date_of_onset    = parse_date(date_of_onset)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(date_of_onset))

    n_dropped <- n_in - nrow(df)
    if (n_dropped > 0) {
      showNotification(
        paste0(n_dropped, " of ", n_in,
               " rows were dropped because their onset date could not be read. ",
               "Accepted formats: dd/mm/yyyy, yyyy-mm-dd, mm/dd/yyyy."),
        type = "warning", duration = 15)
    }

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      showNotification("No usable rows left after date parsing.", type = "error", duration = 15)
      dataset(NULL)
      return()
    }

    dataset(df)
  }, error = function(e) {
    showNotification(paste("Could not read the uploaded file:", e$message),
                     type = "error", duration = 15)
    dataset(NULL)
  })
})

```

```{r model-functions}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# differential equations
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# SI model ODE
si_ode <- function(time, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    dS <- -beta * S * I / N
    dI <- beta * S * I / N
    list(c(dS, dI))
  })
}

# SIR model ODE
sir_ode <- function(time, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    dS <- -beta * S * I / N
    dI <- beta * S * I / N - gamma * I
    dR <- gamma * I
    list(c(dS, dI, dR))
  })
}

# SEIR model ODE
seir_ode <- function(time, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    dS <- -beta * S * I / N
    dE <- beta * S * I / N - sigma * E
    dI <- sigma * E - gamma * I
    dR <- gamma * I
    list(c(dS, dE, dI, dR))
  })
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# one solver used by BOTH modules
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Every simulated curve in the dashboard - simulated-only mode, real-vs-
# simulated mode, every confidence-band draw and every comparison replicate -
# goes through this single function, so the compartment definitions cannot
# drift between modules.
#
#   N      total population at risk (NOT the number of case records)
#   init   named list/vector with S, I and, where the model needs them, E and R
#   days   number of days to integrate (day 0 .. day `days`)
run_model <- function(model_type, N, beta, sigma = NULL, gamma = NULL, days,
                      init, start_date = as.Date("2020-01-01")) {

  stopifnot(is.numeric(N), length(N) == 1, is.finite(N), N > 0)
  stopifnot(is.numeric(days), length(days) == 1, is.finite(days), days >= 1)

  g <- function(nm, default = 0) {
    v <- init[[nm]]
    if (is.null(v) || !is.finite(v)) default else as.numeric(v)
  }

  times <- seq(0, round(days), by = 1)

  if (model_type == "SI") {
    state <- c(S = g("S", N - 1), I = g("I", 1))
    parms <- c(beta = beta, N = N)
    fun   <- si_ode
  } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
    state <- c(S = g("S", N - 1), I = g("I", 1), R = g("R", 0))
    parms <- c(beta = beta, gamma = gamma, N = N)
    fun   <- sir_ode
  } else if (model_type == "SEIR") {
    state <- c(S = g("S", N - 1), E = g("E", 0), I = g("I", 1), R = g("R", 0))
    parms <- c(beta = beta, sigma = sigma, gamma = gamma, N = N)
    fun   <- seir_ode
  } else {
    stop("Unknown model type: ", model_type)
  }

  # explicit tolerances: the lsoda defaults (1e-6) are loose enough that the
  # same run can differ in the third decimal between platforms, which makes
  # the app impossible to check against independently written code.
  sim <- ode(y = state, times = times, func = fun, parms = parms,
             atol = 1e-10, rtol = 1e-10)
  sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim)
  sim_df$Date <- start_date + sim_df$time

  # incident infections per day, i.e. the people who LEAVE S. This is the
  # simulated counterpart of observed incidence and is what the comparison
  # table uses for peak incidence and outbreak duration. (Cumulative
  # infections is read off S instead - see series_metrics.)
  sim_df$new_infections <- c(0, pmax(0, -diff(sim_df$S)))
  sim_df$cum_infections <- cumsum(sim_df$new_infections)

  sim_df
}

# thin wrappers kept so existing calls and the user manual stay valid
run_si_model <- function(N, beta, days, initial_S = NULL, initial_I = NULL) {
  run_model("SI", N, beta, days = days, init = list(S = initial_S, I = initial_I))
}

run_sir_model <- function(N, beta, gamma, days, initial_S = NULL, initial_I = NULL, initial_R = NULL) {
  run_model("SIR", N, beta, gamma = gamma, days = days,
            init = list(S = initial_S, I = initial_I, R = initial_R))
}

run_seir_model <- function(N, beta, sigma, gamma, days,
                           initial_S = NULL, initial_E = NULL, initial_I = NULL, initial_R = NULL) {
  run_model("SEIR", N, beta, sigma = sigma, gamma = gamma, days = days,
            init = list(S = initial_S, E = initial_E, I = initial_I, R = initial_R))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# observed (real) data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Line list -> daily event counts. Every reconstruction in the app starts here,
# so the SI / SIR / SEIR branches cannot disagree about what a "case" is.
#
# Cases whose exposure date is missing (or later than onset) get an imputed
# exposure date = onset - mean observed incubation period, otherwise they would
# enter I without ever passing through E and drive E_real negative.
observed_events <- function(dataset, gamma = NULL) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(dataset), nrow(dataset) > 0)

  onset <- as.Date(dataset$date_of_onset)
  expo  <- if ("date_of_exposure" %in% names(dataset)) as.Date(dataset$date_of_exposure) else as.Date(rep(NA, length(onset)))

  keep  <- !is.na(onset)
  onset <- onset[keep]; expo <- expo[keep]

  incub <- as.numeric(onset - expo)
  valid <- incub[!is.na(incub) & incub >= 0]
  mean_incub <- if (length(valid) > 0) round(mean(valid)) else 0

  bad <- is.na(expo) | expo > onset
  expo[bad] <- onset[bad] - mean_incub

  recovery_days <- if (!is.null(gamma) && is.finite(gamma) && gamma > 0) ceiling(1 / gamma) else 7
  recov <- onset + recovery_days

  list(exposure = expo, onset = onset, recovery = recov,
       n_cases = length(onset), mean_incubation = mean_incub,
       recovery_days = recovery_days)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# which date counts as "the infection happened"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SI and SIR both go straight from S to I - neither has a latent class - yet
# the app as received reads that transition from a different column in each:
# SI uses date_of_exposure, SIR uses date_of_onset. For the same file the two
# models therefore place the same case on different days, and start the window
# on different days.
#
# Which one is right is an epidemiological judgement, not a bug to be fixed
# quietly, so it is now an explicit choice with the ORIGINAL behaviour as the
# default. "default" reproduces exactly what the app did before:
#
#   event = "default"   SI -> exposure, SIR -> onset   (unchanged behaviour)
#   event = "exposure"  both read the S -> I transition from date_of_exposure
#   event = "onset"     both read it from date_of_onset
#
# SEIR is unaffected: it needs both columns by construction (exposure enters E,
# onset moves E to I), so the setting does not apply to it.
resolve_event <- function(model_type, event = "default") {
  if (model_type == "SEIR") return("seir")
  if (is.null(event) || !nzchar(event) || event == "default") {
    switch(model_type, "SI" = "exposure", "SIR" = "onset")
  } else {
    match.arg(event, c("exposure", "onset"))
  }
}

# The date on which each case is taken to have entered I, and the date it
# leaves again. Infectiousness is measured from the infection event, so if the
# event is the exposure date the recovery date shifts with it.
infection_dates <- function(ev, model_type, event = "default") {
  w <- resolve_event(model_type, event)
  infect <- if (w == "onset") ev$onset else ev$exposure
  list(infection = infect, recovery = infect + ev$recovery_days, which = w)
}

# The date grid a real-vs-simulated run is evaluated on.
# `extra_days` lets the user run the simulation past the end of the observed
# data; the observed series simply stops where the data stops.
observed_window <- function(dataset, model_type, gamma = NULL, extra_days = 0,
                            event = "default") {
  ev <- observed_events(dataset, gamma)

  if (model_type == "SEIR") {
    start_date <- min(ev$exposure)
    end_date   <- max(ev$recovery) + 5
  } else {
    inf <- infection_dates(ev, model_type, event)
    start_date <- min(inf$infection)
    end_date   <- if (model_type == "SI") max(inf$infection) + 5 else max(inf$recovery) + 5
  }

  end_date <- end_date + max(0, round(extra_days))

  list(dates = seq.Date(start_date, end_date, by = "day"),
       start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date, events = ev)
}

# Reconstruct the observed compartments on a given date grid.
#
# Three quantities are produced and kept distinct, because the review found
# them conflated:
#   new_*       observed INCIDENCE  - cases with that event date (day 1 included)
#   cum_I_real  CUMULATIVE INFECTIONS - everyone infected up to and including that day
#   I_real      reconstructed infectious PREVALENCE - still infectious on that day
#
# Prevalence is built with cumsum() over the full grid (the previous version
# started its loop at t = 2 and silently discarded every case dated on the
# first day of the window).
reconstruct_observed <- function(dataset, model_type, dates, N, gamma = NULL,
                                 event = "default") {
  dates <- as.Date(dates)
  ev    <- observed_events(dataset, gamma)

  count_on <- function(d) {
    tab <- table(factor(as.character(d), levels = as.character(dates)))
    as.numeric(tab)
  }

  if (model_type != "SEIR") {
    inf <- infection_dates(ev, model_type, event)
    new_inf <- count_on(inf$infection)
    new_rec <- count_on(inf$recovery)
  } else {
    new_inf <- NULL; new_rec <- NULL
  }

  new_E <- count_on(ev$exposure)
  new_I <- count_on(ev$onset)
  new_R <- count_on(ev$recovery)

  out <- data.frame(Date = dates, new_E = new_E, new_I = new_I, new_R = new_R)

  cum_E <- cumsum(new_E)
  cum_I <- cumsum(new_I)
  cum_R <- cumsum(new_R)

  if (model_type == "SI") {
    # SI has no latent and no recovered class: the infection event IS the
    # moment the case becomes infectious, and nobody ever leaves I
    cum_inf <- cumsum(new_inf)
    out$new_infections <- new_inf
    out$cum_I_real     <- cum_inf
    out$S_real <- N - cum_inf
    out$I_real <- cum_inf
    out$E_real <- NA_real_
    out$R_real <- NA_real_
  } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
    cum_inf <- cumsum(new_inf)
    cum_rec <- cumsum(new_rec)
    out$new_infections <- new_inf
    out$cum_I_real     <- cum_inf
    out$S_real <- N - cum_inf
    out$I_real <- cum_inf - cum_rec
    out$E_real <- NA_real_
    out$R_real <- cum_rec
  } else {                       # SEIR
    # the infection event is the EXPOSURE; onset is the E -> I transition
    out$new_infections <- new_E
    out$cum_I_real     <- cum_E
    out$S_real <- N - cum_E
    out$E_real <- cum_E - cum_I
    out$I_real <- cum_I - cum_R
    out$R_real <- cum_R
  }

  for (cl in c("S_real", "E_real", "I_real", "R_real")) {
    out[[cl]] <- pmax(0, out[[cl]])
  }

  out
}

# Initial conditions for the real-vs-simulated module, read off the data at the
# first day of the window instead of always seeding one infected individual.
estimate_initial_conditions <- function(dataset, model_type, N, gamma = NULL, extra_days = 0,
                                        event = "default") {
  win <- observed_window(dataset, model_type, gamma, extra_days, event)
  obs <- reconstruct_observed(dataset, model_type, win$dates, N, gamma, event)
  first <- obs[1, ]

  if (model_type == "SI") {
    I0 <- max(first$I_real, 1)
    init <- list(S = N - I0, I = I0)
  } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
    I0 <- max(first$I_real, 1)
    R0c <- first$R_real
    init <- list(S = N - I0 - R0c, I = I0, R = R0c)
  } else {
    E0  <- first$E_real
    I0  <- first$I_real
    R0c <- first$R_real
    if (E0 + I0 < 1) I0 <- 1          # the outbreak has to start somewhere
    init <- list(S = N - E0 - I0 - R0c, E = E0, I = I0, R = R0c)
  }

  init <- lapply(init, function(v) max(0, round(as.numeric(v))))
  init$.window <- win
  init
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# real vs. simulated
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# N and `init` are now supplied by the caller (ultimately by the user). The
# function no longer invents N = nrow(dataset) nor seeds S = N-1, I = 1.
run_real_model <- function(dataset, model_type, beta, sigma = NULL, gamma = NULL,
                           N, init = NULL, extra_days = 0, event = "default") {

  stopifnot(!missing(N), is.numeric(N), is.finite(N), N > 0)

  win   <- observed_window(dataset, model_type, gamma, extra_days, event)
  dates <- win$dates

  if (is.null(init)) {
    init <- estimate_initial_conditions(dataset, model_type, N, gamma, extra_days, event)
  }
  init <- init[intersect(names(init), c("S", "E", "I", "R"))]

  sim_df <- run_model(model_type, N = N, beta = beta, sigma = sigma, gamma = gamma,
                      days = length(dates) - 1, init = init, start_date = win$start_date)

  obs <- reconstruct_observed(dataset, model_type, dates, N, gamma, event)

  obs_cols <- c("Date", "new_infections", "cum_I_real",
                intersect(c("S_real", "E_real", "I_real", "R_real"), names(obs)))
  obs <- obs[, obs_cols]
  names(obs)[names(obs) == "new_infections"] <- "new_infections_real"

  out <- dplyr::left_join(sim_df, obs, by = "Date")
  attr(out, "N") <- N
  attr(out, "init") <- init
  attr(out, "window") <- win
  attr(out, "event") <- resolve_event(model_type, event)
  out
}
```

```{r bootstrap-comparison-functions}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# uncertainty: where the confidence bands come from
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The bands shown in the dashboard are PARAMETER-UNCERTAINTY intervals for the
# simulated scenario. The procedure is:
#
#   1. draw CI_N_DRAWS parameter sets around the values the user set,
#   2. integrate the ODE once per draw on the same grid and from the same
#      initial conditions as the displayed curve,
#   3. report the per-day empirical quantiles of those trajectories.
#
# Nothing is smoothed and nothing is stretched to cover the point estimate.
# (The previous version ran a loess over the quantiles and then forced
# low <= point estimate <= high, which produced bands that no longer
# corresponded to any quantile of the simulated distribution.)
#
# Draws are lognormal so they stay strictly positive and need no truncation;
# the MEDIAN of each draw distribution is the value the user set, so the band
# is centred on the curve that is plotted.
rlnorm_cv <- function(n, median_val, cv) {
  if (!is.finite(median_val) || median_val <= 0 || !is.finite(cv) || cv <= 0) {
    return(rep(median_val, n))
  }
  sdlog <- sqrt(log(1 + cv^2))
  rlnorm(n, meanlog = log(median_val), sdlog = sdlog)
}

# Coefficient of variation used for beta. With a line list we let the data
# speak: EpiEstim gives a posterior for R(t), and its relative spread is used
# as the relative spread of beta. Without data (simulated-only module) the
# user-supplied CV is used directly.
beta_cv_from_data <- function(dataset, default_cv = 0.10) {
  if (is.null(dataset) || nrow(dataset) < 7) return(default_cv)

  out <- tryCatch({
    incidence_data <- dataset %>%
      filter(!is.na(date_of_onset)) %>%
      count(date_of_onset, name = "I") %>%
      arrange(date_of_onset) %>%
      complete(date_of_onset = seq(min(date_of_onset), max(date_of_onset), by = "day"),
               fill = list(I = 0))

    if (nrow(incidence_data) < 7) return(default_cv)

    si <- as.numeric(dataset$date_of_onset - dataset$date_of_exposure)
    si <- si[!is.na(si) & si > 0]
    mean_si <- if (length(si) >= 5) mean(si) else 7.5
    std_si  <- if (length(si) >= 5 && sd(si) > 0) sd(si) else 3.4

    res <- EpiEstim::estimate_R(
      incidence_data$I,
      method = "parametric_si",
      config = EpiEstim::make_config(list(
        mean_si = mean_si, std_si = std_si,
        t_start = 2, t_end = nrow(incidence_data)
      ))
    )

    cv <- stats::median(res$R$`Std(R)` / res$R$`Mean(R)`, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(cv) || cv <= 0) default_cv else min(max(cv, 0.02), 0.75)
  }, error = function(e) default_cv)

  if (is.null(out) || !is.finite(out)) default_cv else out
}

# One parameter-draw generator for both modules.
draw_parameters <- function(model_type, beta, sigma = NULL, gamma = NULL,
                            n_draws = CI_N_DRAWS, param_cv = 0.10, dataset = NULL) {
  b_cv <- if (is.null(dataset)) param_cv else beta_cv_from_data(dataset, param_cv)

  list(
    beta  = rlnorm_cv(n_draws, beta, b_cv),
    sigma = if (model_type == "SEIR" && !is.null(sigma)) rlnorm_cv(n_draws, sigma, param_cv) else rep(NA_real_, n_draws),
    gamma = if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR") && !is.null(gamma)) rlnorm_cv(n_draws, gamma, param_cv) else rep(NA_real_, n_draws),
    beta_cv = b_cv
  )
}

CI_PROBS <- c(0.025, 0.05, 0.125, 0.25, 0.75, 0.875, 0.95, 0.975)
CI_NAMES <- c("ci_2.5", "ci_5", "ci_12.5", "ci_25", "ci_75", "ci_87.5", "ci_95", "ci_97.5")

# Per-day quantiles of the simulated trajectories. Used identically by the
# simulated-only module and the real-vs-simulated module.
simulate_ci <- function(model_type, N, beta, sigma = NULL, gamma = NULL, days, init,
                        start_date = as.Date("2020-01-01"),
                        n_draws = CI_N_DRAWS, param_cv = 0.10,
                        dataset = NULL, seed = 20250908) {

  set.seed(seed)   # reproducible bands
  draws <- draw_parameters(model_type, beta, sigma, gamma, n_draws, param_cv, dataset)

  comps <- switch(model_type,
                  "SI"   = c("S", "I"),
                  "SIR"  = c("S", "I", "R"),
                  "SEIR" = c("S", "E", "I", "R"))

  n_t <- round(days) + 1
  mats <- setNames(lapply(comps, function(x) matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_t, ncol = n_draws)), comps)
  dates <- start_date + seq_len(n_t) - 1

  ok <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(n_draws)) {
    res <- tryCatch(
      run_model(model_type, N = N,
                beta  = draws$beta[i],
                sigma = if (model_type == "SEIR") draws$sigma[i] else NULL,
                gamma = if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) draws$gamma[i] else NULL,
                days = days, init = init, start_date = start_date),
      error = function(e) NULL)

    if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) != n_t) next
    for (cp in comps) mats[[cp]][, i] <- res[[cp]]
    ok <- ok + 1
  }

  if (ok < 10) return(NULL)   # not enough draws to quote a quantile honestly

  ci <- lapply(comps, function(cp) {
    q <- t(apply(mats[[cp]], 1, function(x) {
      x <- x[is.finite(x)]
      if (length(x) < 10) rep(NA_real_, length(CI_PROBS))
      else stats::quantile(x, probs = CI_PROBS, names = FALSE)
    }))
    d <- as.data.frame(q)
    names(d) <- CI_NAMES
    d$Date <- dates
    d
  })
  names(ci) <- comps

  attr(ci, "n_draws")  <- ok
  attr(ci, "beta_cv")  <- draws$beta_cv
  attr(ci, "param_cv") <- param_cv
  ci
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# comparative epidemiological metrics
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Both sides of the comparison now use the SAME definitions, the same time
# origin (day 0 = first day of the shared window) and the same population N.
#
#   Cumulative infections  everyone who left S over the window
#                          simulated: N - S(last day);  observed: total cases
#   Peak infectious        highest number simultaneously infectious
#   Day of peak            days from the start of the shared window
#   Peak daily incidence   largest number of NEW infections in a single day
#   Outbreak duration      first to last day with at least one new infection
#   Attack rate            cumulative infections / N
#
# Previously "infections" was read as tail(I, 1) - the infectious prevalence on
# the final day, not a cumulative count - and both durations were computed as
# max(Date) - min(Date) on a shared grid, so "Reduced Duration" was always 0.
series_metrics <- function(days, susceptible, prevalence, incidence, N) {
  prevalence  <- as.numeric(prevalence)
  incidence   <- as.numeric(incidence)
  susceptible <- as.numeric(susceptible)
  days        <- as.numeric(days)

  # Cumulative infections is read off the susceptible compartment on BOTH
  # sides - N minus whoever is still susceptible at the end. Because the
  # simulated run starts from the same S as the observed series, the two are
  # directly comparable and the people already infected on day 1 are counted
  # once on each side rather than once on one side only.
  cum_inf <- N - tail(susceptible[is.finite(susceptible)], 1)
  active  <- which(incidence >= 1)

  c(
    cumulative_infections = cum_inf,
    peak_prevalence       = if (all(is.na(prevalence))) NA_real_ else max(prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
    peak_prevalence_day   = if (all(is.na(prevalence))) NA_real_ else days[which.max(prevalence)],
    peak_incidence        = if (length(incidence) == 0) NA_real_ else max(incidence, na.rm = TRUE),
    peak_incidence_day    = if (length(incidence) == 0) NA_real_ else days[which.max(incidence)],
    duration              = if (length(active) == 0) 0 else days[max(active)] - days[min(active)],
    attack_rate           = 100 * cum_inf / N
  )
}

simulated_metrics <- function(sim_df, N) {
  series_metrics(sim_df$time, sim_df$S, sim_df$I, sim_df$new_infections, N)
}

observed_metrics <- function(sim_df, N) {
  ok <- !is.na(sim_df$I_real)
  series_metrics(sim_df$time[ok], sim_df$S_real[ok], sim_df$I_real[ok],
                 sim_df$new_infections_real[ok], N)
}

METRIC_LABELS <- c(
  cumulative_infections = "Cumulative infections",
  peak_prevalence       = "Peak infectious (prevalence)",
  peak_prevalence_day   = "Day of peak infectious",
  peak_incidence        = "Peak daily new infections",
  peak_incidence_day    = "Day of peak new infections",
  duration              = "Outbreak duration (days)",
  attack_rate           = "Attack rate (% of N)"
)

METRIC_DESCRIPTIONS <- c(
  cumulative_infections = "Everyone infected by the end of the window (N - final susceptible)",
  peak_prevalence       = "Largest number infectious on any single day",
  peak_prevalence_day   = "Days from the start of the shared window to that peak",
  peak_incidence        = "Largest number of new infections in a single day",
  peak_incidence_day    = "Days from the start of the shared window to that peak",
  duration              = "First to last day with at least one new infection",
  attack_rate           = "Cumulative infections as a percentage of the population at risk"
)

# Comparison table. The OBSERVED column is a single count from the line list
# and carries no interval. The SIMULATED column is the curve that is actually
# plotted - the run at the parameters the user set - so the Comparison tab, the
# Model Parameters tab and the chart cannot disagree; its 95% interval comes
# from the same parameter draws that produce the confidence bands.
comparison_table_data <- function(dataset, model_type, beta, sigma = NULL, gamma = NULL,
                                  N, init, extra_days = 0,
                                  n_draws = CI_N_DRAWS, param_cv = 0.10, seed = 20250908,
                                  event = "default") {

  ref <- run_real_model(dataset, model_type, beta, sigma, gamma,
                        N = N, init = init, extra_days = extra_days, event = event)

  obs <- observed_metrics(ref, N)
  win <- attr(ref, "window")
  days <- length(win$dates) - 1

  set.seed(seed)
  draws <- draw_parameters(model_type, beta, sigma, gamma, n_draws, param_cv, dataset)

  sim_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_draws, ncol = length(obs),
                    dimnames = list(NULL, names(obs)))

  for (i in seq_len(n_draws)) {
    res <- tryCatch(
      run_model(model_type, N = N,
                beta  = draws$beta[i],
                sigma = if (model_type == "SEIR") draws$sigma[i] else NULL,
                gamma = if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) draws$gamma[i] else NULL,
                days = days, init = init, start_date = win$start_date),
      error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(res)) next
    sim_mat[i, ] <- simulated_metrics(res, N)
  }

  # point estimate = the displayed run, NOT the median of the draws
  sim_pt <- simulated_metrics(ref, N)
  sim_lo <- apply(sim_mat, 2, stats::quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  sim_hi <- apply(sim_mat, 2, stats::quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)

  keys <- names(METRIC_LABELS)
  rnd <- function(k, v) if (k == "attack_rate") round(v, 1) else round(v, 0)

  data.frame(
    Metric      = unname(METRIC_LABELS[keys]),
    Description = unname(METRIC_DESCRIPTIONS[keys]),
    Observed    = vapply(keys, function(k) rnd(k, obs[[k]]), numeric(1)),
    Simulated   = vapply(keys, function(k) rnd(k, sim_pt[[k]]), numeric(1)),
    `Simulated 95% CI` = vapply(keys, function(k)
      paste0(rnd(k, sim_lo[[k]]), " to ", rnd(k, sim_hi[[k]])), character(1)),
    Difference  = vapply(keys, function(k) rnd(k, obs[[k]] - sim_pt[[k]]), numeric(1)),
    row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE
  )
}

# Kept so older calls keep working; everything now routes through
# reconstruct_observed() so no second reconstruction can drift from it.
calculate_compartment_counts <- function(dataset, model_type, dates, N_override = NULL,
                                         gamma = NULL, event = "default") {
  N <- if (!is.null(N_override)) N_override else nrow(dataset)
  obs <- reconstruct_observed(dataset, model_type, dates, N, gamma, event)
  data.frame(Date = obs$Date, S = obs$S_real, E = obs$E_real,
             I = obs$I_real, R = obs$R_real)
}
```

```{r viz-functions}
si_viz <- function(results, separate = FALSE, simulation_only = FALSE) {
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(Days = as.numeric(Date - min(Date)))
  
  si_long <- results %>% 
    select(Days, S, I) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(S, I), 
                 names_to = "Compartment", 
                 values_to = "Count") %>%
    mutate(Type = "Simulated") 
  
  if (!simulation_only) {
    real_long <- results %>%
      select(Days, S_real, I_real) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(S_real, I_real), 
                   names_to = "Compartment", 
                   values_to = "Count") %>%
      mutate(Type = "Real",
             Compartment = gsub("_real", "", Compartment))
    
    si_long <- bind_rows(si_long, real_long)
  }
  
  if (separate) {
    hc <- highchart() %>%
      hc_add_series(
        data = si_long %>% filter(Compartment == "S", Type == "Simulated"),
        type = "spline",
        hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
        name = "Susceptible (Simulated)",
        color = "#1f77b4",
        dashStyle = "Dash",
        lineWidth = 2,
        marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
      ) %>%
      hc_title(text = "Susceptible Population", style = list(fontSize = "18px", fontFamily = APP_FONT, fontWeight = "bold")) %>%
      hc_xAxis(
        title = list(text = "Time From Epidemic Onset (Days)", style = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT)),
        labels = list(format = "{value:.0f}")
      ) %>%
      hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Number of Individuals", style = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT))) %>%
      hc_tooltip(
        shared = TRUE,
        crosshairs = TRUE,
        headerFormat = "<b>Day {point.x:.0f}</b><br/>",
        pointFormat = "{series.name}: <b>{point.y:.0f}</b><br/>"
      ) %>%
      hc_legend(enabled = TRUE) %>%
      hc_exporting(
        enabled = TRUE,
        buttons = list(
          contextButton = list(
            menuItems = c("downloadPNG", "downloadPDF")
          )
        ),
        chartOptions = list(
          chart = list(
            backgroundColor = "#FFFFFF"
          )
        )
      ) %>%
      hc_chart(
        backgroundColor = "#FBFBFB",
        style = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT)
      )
    
    if (!simulation_only) {
      hc <- hc %>%
        hc_add_series(
          data = si_long %>% filter(Compartment == "S", Type == "Real"),
          type = "spline",
          hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
          name = "Susceptible (Real)",
          color = "#1f77b4",
          dashStyle = "Solid",
          lineWidth = 2,
          marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
        )
    }
    
    return(hc)
  } else {
    hc <- highchart() %>%
      hc_add_series(
        data = si_long %>% filter(Compartment == "S", Type == "Simulated"),
        type = "spline",
        hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
        name = "Susceptible (Simulated)",
        color = "#1f77b4",
        dashStyle = "Dash",
        lineWidth = 2,
        marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
      ) %>%
      hc_add_series(
        data = si_long %>% filter(Compartment == "I", Type == "Simulated"),
        type = "spline",
        hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
        name = "Infected (Simulated)",
        color = "#d62728",
        dashStyle = "Dash",
        lineWidth = 2,
        marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
      ) %>%
      hc_title(text = "SI Model", style = list(fontSize = "18px", fontFamily = APP_FONT, fontWeight = "bold")) %>%
      hc_xAxis(
        title = list(text = "Time From Epidemic Onset (Days)", style = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT)),
        labels = list(format = "{value:.0f}")
      ) %>%
      hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Number of Individuals", style = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT))) %>%
      hc_tooltip(
        shared = TRUE,
        crosshairs = TRUE,
        headerFormat = "<b>Day {point.x:.0f}</b><br/>",
        pointFormat = "{series.name}: <b>{point.y:.0f}</b><br/>"
      ) %>%
      hc_legend(itemStyle = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT)) %>%
      hc_exporting(
        enabled = TRUE,
        buttons = list(
          contextButton = list(
            menuItems = c("downloadPNG", "downloadPDF")
          )
        ),
        chartOptions = list(
          chart = list(
            backgroundColor = "#FFFFFF"
          )
        )
      ) %>%
      hc_chart(
        backgroundColor = "#FBFBFB",
        style = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT)
      )
    
    if (!simulation_only) {
      hc <- hc %>%
        hc_add_series(
          data = si_long %>% filter(Compartment == "S", Type == "Real"),
          type = "spline",
          hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
          name = "Susceptible (Real)",
          color = "#1f77b4",
          dashStyle = "Solid",
          lineWidth = 2,
          marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
        ) %>%
        hc_add_series(
          data = si_long %>% filter(Compartment == "I", Type == "Real"),
          type = "spline",
          hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
          name = "Infected (Real)",
          color = "#d62728",
          dashStyle = "Solid",
          lineWidth = 2,
          marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
        )
    }
    
    return(hc)
  }

seir_viz <- function(results, separate = FALSE, simulation_only = FALSE) {
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(Days = as.numeric(Date - min(Date)))
  
  seir_long <- results %>%
    select(Days, S, E, I, R) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(S, E, I, R), 
                 names_to = "Compartment", 
                 values_to = "Count") %>%
    mutate(Type = "Simulated")
  
  if (!simulation_only) {
    real_long <- results %>%
      select(Days, S_real, E_real, I_real, R_real) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(S_real, E_real, I_real, R_real), 
                   names_to = "Compartment", 
                   values_to = "Count") %>%
      mutate(Type = "Real",
             Compartment = gsub("_real", "", Compartment))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# single-compartment chart
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Confidence bands belong to the SIMULATED scenario only, in both modules.
# The observed line is a count from the line list, not an estimate, so it is
# drawn without an interval (and the "Show confidence intervals for" selector
# that used to offer Real / Both / Simulated is gone).
compartment_viz <- function(results, compartment, simulation_only = FALSE,
                            sim_ci = NULL,
                            show_ci = list(ci_95 = FALSE, ci_90 = FALSE, ci_75 = FALSE, ci_50 = FALSE)) {

  if (!is.null(results$Date) && all(!is.na(results$Date)) && inherits(results$Date, "Date")) {
    min_date <- min(results$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
    results <- results %>%
      mutate(Days = as.numeric(Date - min_date))
  } else {
    results <- results %>%
      mutate(Days = row_number() - 1)
  }

  comp_colors <- c(
    "S" = "#1f77b4",
    "E" = "#a51ebd",
    "I" = "#d62728",
    "R" = "#2ca02c"
  )

  comp_name <- switch(compartment,
                     "susceptible" = "S",
                     "exposed" = "E",
                     "infected" = "I",
                     "recovered" = "R")

  comp_title <- switch(compartment,
                      "susceptible" = "Susceptible",
                      "exposed" = "Exposed",
                      "infected" = "Infected",
                      "recovered" = "Recovered")

  if (is.null(comp_name) || !comp_name %in% names(results)) return(highchart())

  real_col <- paste0(comp_name, "_real")
  has_real <- !simulation_only && real_col %in% names(results) &&
              any(!is.na(results[[real_col]]))

  if (has_real) {
    long_data <- results %>%
      select(Days, !!sym(comp_name), !!sym(real_col)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(!!sym(comp_name), !!sym(real_col)), names_to = "Compartment", values_to = "Count") %>%
      mutate(Type = ifelse(Compartment == comp_name, "Simulated", "Real"),
             Compartment = gsub("_real", "", Compartment))
  } else {
    long_data <- results %>%
      select(Days, !!sym(comp_name)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(!!sym(comp_name)), names_to = "Compartment", values_to = "Count") %>%
      mutate(Type = "Simulated")
  }

  hc <- highchart() %>%
    hc_title(text = paste0(comp_title, " Population"),
             style = list(fontSize = "18px", fontFamily = APP_FONT, fontWeight = "bold")) %>%
    hc_xAxis(
      title = list(text = "Time From Epidemic Onset (Days)", style = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT)),
      labels = list(format = "{value:.0f}")
    ) %>%
    hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Number of Individuals", style = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT))) %>%
    hc_tooltip(
      shared = TRUE,
      crosshairs = TRUE,
      formatter = JS("
        function () {
          var points = this.points;
          var tooltip = '<b>Day ' + this.x.toFixed(0) + '</b><br/>';
          points.forEach(function(point) {
            if (point.series.type === 'areasplinerange') {
              tooltip += point.series.name + ': <b>' + point.point.low.toFixed(0) + ' - ' + point.point.high.toFixed(0) + '</b><br/>';
            } else {
              tooltip += point.series.name + ': <b>' + point.y.toFixed(0) + '</b><br/>';
            }
          });
          return tooltip;
        }
      ")
    ) %>%
    hc_legend(enabled = TRUE) %>%
    hc_exporting(
      enabled = TRUE,
      buttons = list(
        contextButton = list(
          menuItems = c("downloadPNG", "downloadPDF")
        )
      ),
      chartOptions = list(
        chart = list(
          backgroundColor = "#FFFFFF"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    hc_chart(
      backgroundColor = "#FBFBFB",
      style = list(fontFamily = APP_FONT)
    )

  # ---- simulated confidence bands -----------------------------------------
  ci_data <- if (!is.null(sim_ci)) sim_ci[[comp_name]] else NULL

  if (!is.null(ci_data) && "Date" %in% names(ci_data) && nrow(ci_data) > 0) {

    ci_days <- ci_data %>%
      mutate(Days = as.numeric(Date - min(results$Date, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
      filter(Days %in% results$Days) %>%
      select(Days, starts_with("ci_"))

    # widest band first so the narrower ones stay visible on top of it
    add_ci_band <- function(hc, low_col, high_col, level, opacity) {
      band_data <- ci_days %>%
        select(Days, low = !!sym(low_col), high = !!sym(high_col)) %>%
        filter(is.finite(low), is.finite(high))

      if (nrow(band_data) == 0) return(hc)

      # quantiles of a population size cannot be negative; no other adjustment
      # is applied, so the band is exactly the empirical quantile envelope.
      band_data$low  <- pmax(0, band_data$low)
      band_data$high <- pmax(band_data$high, band_data$low)

      hc %>%
        hc_add_series(
          data = list_parse(band_data),
          type = "areasplinerange",
          name = paste0(comp_title, " Simulated CI ", level, "%"),
          color = paste0("rgba(", paste(col2rgb(comp_colors[comp_name]), collapse = ","), ", ", opacity, ")"),
          fillOpacity = opacity,
          lineWidth = 0,
          marker = list(enabled = FALSE),
          zIndex = 1
        )
    }

    if (isTRUE(show_ci$ci_95)) hc <- add_ci_band(hc, "ci_2.5",  "ci_97.5", "95", 0.15)
    if (isTRUE(show_ci$ci_90)) hc <- add_ci_band(hc, "ci_5",    "ci_95",   "90", 0.25)
    if (isTRUE(show_ci$ci_75)) hc <- add_ci_band(hc, "ci_12.5", "ci_87.5", "75", 0.35)
    if (isTRUE(show_ci$ci_50)) hc <- add_ci_band(hc, "ci_25",   "ci_75",   "50", 0.45)
  }

  hc <- hc %>%
    hc_add_series(
      data = long_data %>% filter(Type == "Simulated"),
      type = "spline",
      hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
      name = paste0(comp_title, " (Simulated)"),
      color = comp_colors[comp_name],
      dashStyle = "Dash",
      lineWidth = 2,
      marker = list(enabled = FALSE),
      zIndex = 5
    )

  if (has_real) {
    hc <- hc %>%
      hc_add_series(
        data = long_data %>% filter(Type == "Real"),
        type = "spline",
        hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
        name = paste0(comp_title, " (Real)"),
        color = comp_colors[comp_name],
        dashStyle = "Solid",
        lineWidth = 2,
        marker = list(enabled = FALSE),
        zIndex = 6
      )
  }

  return(hc)
}
```

```{r params-functions}
custom_datatable <- function(params) {
  datatable(
    params,
    rownames = FALSE,
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    options = list(
      dom = 'Brt',
      buttons = c('csv','excel', 'pdf'),
      pageLength = nrow(params),
      scrollY = "230px",
      scrollCollapse = TRUE,
      paging = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(params),
      fontSize = '14px',
      fontFamily = APP_FONT
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(params),
      target = 'row',
      borderBottom = '1px solid #ddd'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(params),
      backgroundColor = 'white'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      'Parameter',
      fontWeight = 'bold'
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# model parameters table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One builder for both modules, so a row called "Cumulative infections" means
# the same thing everywhere and is computed by the same helper that fills the
# Comparison tab.
params_table_data <- function(model_type, N, beta, sigma = NULL, gamma = NULL,
                              results, init, simulation_only = TRUE, dataset = NULL,
                              event = "default") {

  row <- function(p, d, v) data.frame(Parameter = p, Description = d, Value = as.character(v),
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  n0 <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || !is.finite(x)) 0 else x
  fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) formatC(round(as.numeric(x), digits), format = "f",
                                         digits = digits, big.mark = "")

  sim_m <- simulated_metrics(results, N)

  # When N still equals the number of case records, say so in the output. The
  # review objected to that being ASSUMED; stating it on every run means the
  # reader can see the assumption instead of inheriting it silently.
  n_note <- if (!simulation_only && !is.null(dataset) && isTRUE(N == nrow(dataset))) {
    paste0("Total population at risk - WARNING: still equal to the ", nrow(dataset),
           " case records, which is a placeholder, not a population at risk")
  } else if (!simulation_only) {
    "Total population at risk (set by the user)"
  } else {
    "Total population size"
  }

  out <- list(
    row("N", n_note, fmt(N)),
    row("Beta", "Transmission rate (per day)", fmt(beta, 3))
  )

  if (model_type == "SEIR") {
    out <- c(out, list(row("Sigma", "Exposure (onset) rate, per day", fmt(sigma, 3))))
  }
  if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) {
    out <- c(out, list(
      row("Gamma", "Recovery rate (per day)", fmt(gamma, 3)),
      row("R0", "Basic reproduction number (Beta / Gamma)", fmt(beta / gamma, 3))
    ))
  }

  # initial conditions actually handed to the solver
  src <- if (simulation_only) "(set in the sidebar)" else "(from the sidebar; defaults estimated from the uploaded data)"
  out <- c(out, list(row("Initial S", paste("Initial susceptible", src), fmt(n0(init$S)))))
  if (model_type == "SEIR") {
    out <- c(out, list(row("Initial E", paste("Initial exposed", src), fmt(n0(init$E)))))
  }
  out <- c(out, list(row("Initial I", paste("Initial infected", src), fmt(n0(init$I)))))
  if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) {
    out <- c(out, list(row("Initial R", paste("Initial recovered", src), fmt(n0(init$R)))))
  }

  # final state of the simulated run
  out <- c(out, list(row("Final S (simulated)", "Susceptible on the last simulated day", fmt(tail(results$S, 1)))))
  if (model_type == "SEIR") {
    out <- c(out, list(row("Final E (simulated)", "Exposed on the last simulated day", fmt(tail(results$E, 1)))))
  }
  out <- c(out, list(row("Final I (simulated)", "Infectious on the last simulated day", fmt(tail(results$I, 1)))))
  if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) {
    out <- c(out, list(row("Final R (simulated)", "Recovered on the last simulated day", fmt(tail(results$R, 1)))))
  }

  out <- c(out, list(
    row("Cumulative infections (simulated)", "Everyone infected over the run (N - final susceptible)", fmt(sim_m[["cumulative_infections"]])),
    row("Peak infectious (simulated)", "Largest number infectious on any single day", fmt(sim_m[["peak_prevalence"]])),
    row("Day of peak (simulated)", "Days from the start of the run to that peak", paste0("Day ", fmt(sim_m[["peak_prevalence_day"]]))),
    row("Outbreak duration (simulated)", "First to last day with at least one new infection", fmt(sim_m[["duration"]])),
    row("Attack rate (simulated)", "Cumulative infections as a percentage of N", paste0(fmt(sim_m[["attack_rate"]], 1), " %")),
    row("Simulated run length", "Days integrated (day 0 to the last day)", fmt(max(results$time)))
  ))

  if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) {
    out <- c(out, list(row("Infectious period", "Average time infectious (1 / Gamma, days)", fmt(1 / gamma, 1))))
  }
  if (model_type == "SEIR") {
    out <- c(out, list(row("Incubation period", "Average time exposed (1 / Sigma, days)", fmt(1 / sigma, 1))))
  }

  # ---- observed side ------------------------------------------------------
  if (!simulation_only && !is.null(dataset)) {
    obs_m <- observed_metrics(results, N)
    ev <- observed_events(dataset, gamma)

    out <- c(out, list(
      row("Cases in file", "Rows with a usable onset date", fmt(ev$n_cases)),
      row("Cumulative infections (observed)", "Total cases recorded over the observed window", fmt(obs_m[["cumulative_infections"]])),
      row("Peak infectious (observed)", "Largest reconstructed infectious prevalence", fmt(obs_m[["peak_prevalence"]])),
      row("Day of peak (observed)", "Days from the start of the shared window to that peak", paste0("Day ", fmt(obs_m[["peak_prevalence_day"]]))),
      row("Peak daily cases (observed)", "Largest number of new cases in a single day", fmt(obs_m[["peak_incidence"]])),
      row("Outbreak duration (observed)", "First to last day with at least one new case", fmt(obs_m[["duration"]])),
      row("Attack rate (observed)", "Observed cases as a percentage of N", paste0(fmt(obs_m[["attack_rate"]], 1), " %"))
    ))

    if (model_type == "SEIR") {
      incub <- as.numeric(ev$onset - ev$exposure)
      incub <- incub[is.finite(incub)]
      out <- c(out, list(row(
        "Observed incubation period",
        "Exposure to onset in the uploaded line list (days)",
        if (length(incub) > 0)
          paste0("Mean ", round(mean(incub), 1), " (range ", min(incub), "-", max(incub), ")")
        else "Not available")))
    }

    out <- c(out, list(row(
      "Assumed recovery delay",
      "Infection to recovery used to reconstruct the observed R compartment (ceiling(1 / Gamma))",
      paste0(ev$recovery_days, " days"))))

    if (model_type != "SEIR") {
      w <- resolve_event(model_type, event)
      out <- c(out, list(row(
        "Observed infection event",
        "Column read as the S to I transition when reconstructing the observed curve",
        paste0(if (w == "onset") "date_of_onset" else "date_of_exposure",
               if (is.null(event) || event == "default") "  (model default)" else "  (set in the sidebar)"))))
    }
  }

  do.call(rbind, out)
}

# wrappers kept for readability at the call sites
si_params_table   <- function(N, beta, days, results, init)                      custom_datatable(params_table_data("SI",   N, beta, NULL,  NULL,  results, init, TRUE))
sir_params_table  <- function(N, beta, gamma, days, results, init)               custom_datatable(params_table_data("SIR",  N, beta, NULL,  gamma, results, init, TRUE))
seir_params_table <- function(N, beta, sigma, gamma, days, results, init)        custom_datatable(params_table_data("SEIR", N, beta, sigma, gamma, results, init, TRUE))

real_si_params_table   <- function(dataset, beta, results, N, init)              custom_datatable(params_table_data("SI",   N, beta, NULL,  NULL,  results, init, FALSE, dataset))
real_sir_params_table  <- function(dataset, beta, gamma, results, N, init)       custom_datatable(params_table_data("SIR",  N, beta, NULL,  gamma, results, init, FALSE, dataset))
real_seir_params_table <- function(dataset, beta, sigma, gamma, results, N, init) custom_datatable(params_table_data("SEIR", N, beta, sigma, gamma, results, init, FALSE, dataset))
```

```{r create-and-render-demographic-summary}

create_demographic_summary <- function(df, var_name) {
  if (var_name == "age_group") {
    df <- df %>% mutate(age_group = as.numeric(as.character(age_group)))
    summary_df <- df %>%
      summarise(
        N = n(),
        Mean = round(mean(age_group, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        SD = round(sd(age_group, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        Median = median(age_group, na.rm = TRUE),
        Min = min(age_group, na.rm = TRUE),
        Max = max(age_group, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  } else {
    df <- df %>% mutate(!!var_name := as.factor(as.character(.data[[var_name]])))
    summary_df <- df %>%
      group_by(.data[[var_name]]) %>%
      summarise(Count = n()) %>%
      mutate(Percentage = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
      rename(Category = 1)
  }
  return(summary_df)
}

render_demographic_table <- function(summary_df) {
  if ("Mean" %in% names(summary_df)) {
    datatable(
      summary_df,
      rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(
        dom = 't',
        pageLength = nrow(summary_df)
      )
    ) %>%
      formatStyle(
        columns = 1:ncol(summary_df),
        fontSize = '14px',
        fontFamily = APP_FONT
      ) %>%
      formatRound(columns = c("Mean", "SD"), digits = 2)
  } else {
    datatable(
      summary_df,
      rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(
        dom = 't',
        pageLength = nrow(summary_df)
      )
    ) %>%
      formatStyle(
        columns = 1:ncol(summary_df),
        fontSize = '14px',
        fontFamily = APP_FONT
      ) %>%
      formatPercentage('Percentage', 1)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r app-observers}
# shinyjs renders its <script> and <link> tags into the HEAD slot, and a knitr
# chunk in a flexdashboard only emits the BODY slot - so a plain useShinyjs()
# call here is silently dropped and every shinyjs::disable()/enable() in the
# app becomes a no-op. (That is why the previous version's "choose N >= cases"
# guard never actually stopped anyone pressing Run.) Emitting the head markup
# into the body instead gets the scripts onto the page; browsers execute
# scripts in the body just the same.
htmltools::HTML(htmltools::renderTags(shinyjs::useShinyjs())$head)

# anything that invalidates the last run
observeEvent(list(
  input$model, input$N, input$days, input$simulation_only, input$N_real, input$extra_days,
  input$beta, input$sigma, input$gamma, input$obs_event,
  input$initial_S_si, input$initial_I_si,
  input$initial_S_sir, input$initial_I_sir, input$initial_R_sir,
  input$initial_S_seir, input$initial_E_seir, input$initial_I_seir, input$initial_R_seir,
  input$file1
), {
  params_changed(TRUE)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers shared by the observers below
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
active_N <- reactive({
  if (isTRUE(input$simulation_only)) input$N else input$N_real
})

current_init <- reactive({
  switch(input$model,
    "SI"   = list(S = input$initial_S_si,   I = input$initial_I_si),
    "SIR"  = list(S = input$initial_S_sir,  I = input$initial_I_sir,  R = input$initial_R_sir),
    "SEIR" = list(S = input$initial_S_seir, E = input$initial_E_seir,
                  I = input$initial_I_seir, R = input$initial_R_seir))
})

push_init <- function(model_type, init) {
  if (model_type == "SI") {
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_S_si", value = init$S)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_I_si", value = init$I)
  } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_S_sir", value = init$S)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_I_sir", value = init$I)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_R_sir", value = init$R)
  } else {
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_S_seir", value = init$S)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_E_seir", value = init$E)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_I_seir", value = init$I)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_R_seir", value = init$R)
  }
}

# Suggested initial conditions.
#  - simulated-only: the textbook seed, S = N - 1, I = 1
#  - real vs simulated: read off the uploaded data on the first day of the
#    window (who is already exposed / symptomatic / recovered), so the
#    simulated epidemic starts from the same place the observed one does
#    instead of always from a single infected individual.
suggest_init <- function(model_type, N, df = NULL, gamma = NULL, extra_days = 0,
                         event = "default") {
  if (is.null(df)) {
    return(switch(model_type,
      "SI"   = list(S = N - 1, I = 1),
      "SIR"  = list(S = N - 1, I = 1, R = 0),
      "SEIR" = list(S = N - 1, E = 0, I = 1, R = 0)))
  }
  est <- tryCatch(estimate_initial_conditions(df, model_type, N, gamma, extra_days, event),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(est)) {
    return(switch(model_type,
      "SI"   = list(S = N - 1, I = 1),
      "SIR"  = list(S = N - 1, I = 1, R = 0),
      "SEIR" = list(S = N - 1, E = 0, I = 1, R = 0)))
  }
  est[intersect(names(est), c("S", "E", "I", "R"))]
}

# refresh the suggested initial values whenever the things they depend on move
# (not when the user edits the initial values themselves)
observeEvent(list(input$model, active_N(), dataset(), input$simulation_only,
                  input$gamma, input$extra_days, input$obs_event), {
  req(input$model)
  N <- active_N()
  req(is.numeric(N), length(N) == 1, is.finite(N), N > 0)

  df <- if (isTRUE(input$simulation_only)) NULL else dataset()
  push_init(input$model, suggest_init(input$model, N, df, input$gamma,
                                      input$extra_days %||% 0, input$obs_event %||% "default"))
}, ignoreInit = FALSE)

observeEvent(input$reset_initials, {
  req(input$model)
  N <- active_N(); req(is.finite(N), N > 0)
  df <- if (isTRUE(input$simulation_only)) NULL else dataset()
  push_init(input$model, suggest_init(input$model, N, df, input$gamma,
                                      input$extra_days %||% 0, input$obs_event %||% "default"))
  showNotification("Initial values reset to the suggested defaults.", type = "message", duration = 5)
})

# The upload pre-fills N with the case count so the box is never empty and the
# model runs straight away, and says plainly that this is a placeholder. The
# assumption is declared on every run rather than made silently: see the hint
# under the field and the "Total population at risk" row of the Model
# Parameters table.
observeEvent(dataset(), {
  df <- dataset()
  req(df)
  updateNumericInput(session, "N_real", value = nrow(df), min = 1)
  showNotification(
    paste0("Loaded ", nrow(df), " cases. 'Total Population at Risk (N)' has been pre-filled ",
           "with ", nrow(df), ", which is only the number of cases, not a population at risk. ",
           "You can run the model now, but replace N with the population these cases arose ",
           "from before reading anything into the comparison."),
    type = "warning", duration = 20, id = "need_n")
})

# the run stays blocked until N is present and large enough to hold the cases
observe({
  if (isTRUE(input$simulation_only)) {
    shinyjs::enable("run_model")
    removeNotification("n_missing"); removeNotification("n_too_small")
    return()
  }

  df <- dataset()
  if (is.null(df)) { shinyjs::disable("run_model"); return() }

  if (is.null(input$N_real) || !is.finite(input$N_real)) {
    shinyjs::disable("run_model")
    removeNotification("n_too_small")
    showNotification("Enter the total population at risk (N) to run the model.",
                     type = "warning", duration = NULL, id = "n_missing")
  } else if (input$N_real < nrow(df)) {   # N can never be smaller than the cases it must hold
    shinyjs::disable("run_model")
    removeNotification("n_missing")
    showNotification(
      paste0("Your file contains ", nrow(df), " cases; N must be at least ", nrow(df), "."),
      type = "error", duration = NULL, id = "n_too_small")
  } else {
    shinyjs::enable("run_model")
    removeNotification("n_missing"); removeNotification("n_too_small")
    removeNotification("need_n")
  }
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# run
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
observeEvent(input$run_model, {
  withProgress(message = 'Running model...', value = 0, {
    params_changed(FALSE)

    tryCatch({
      req(input$model, input$beta)
      run_clicked(TRUE)

      sim_only <- isTRUE(input$simulation_only)
      model_type <- input$model

      if (model_type == "SEIR") req(input$sigma, input$gamma)
      if (model_type == "SIR")  req(input$gamma)

      current_N <- active_N()
      if (is.null(current_N) || !is.numeric(current_N) || !is.finite(current_N) || current_N <= 0) {
        showNotification(
          if (sim_only) "Enter the total population (N) before running the model."
          else paste0("Enter the total population at risk (N) before running the model. ",
                      "It is the population the uploaded cases arose from, not the number of cases."),
          type = "error", duration = 12)
        return()
      }
      if (!sim_only && !is.null(dataset()) && current_N < nrow(dataset())) {
        showNotification(
          paste0("N must be at least ", nrow(dataset()), " - the number of cases in the file."),
          type = "error", duration = 12)
        return()
      }

      init <- lapply(current_init(), function(v) if (is.null(v) || !is.finite(v)) 0 else as.numeric(v))

      sum_compartments <- sum(unlist(init))
      if (abs(sum_compartments - current_N) > 1e-6) {
        showNotification(
          paste0("Initial compartments must sum to N (", current_N, "). Current sum: ",
                 sum_compartments, ". They have been reset to the suggested values - ",
                 "press Run Model Simulation again."),
          type = "error", duration = 12)
        df0 <- if (sim_only) NULL else dataset()
        push_init(model_type, suggest_init(model_type, current_N, df0, input$gamma,
                                           input$extra_days %||% 0, input$obs_event %||% "default"))
        return()
      }

      incProgress(0.4, detail = "Computing model...")

      if (sim_only) {
        req(input$days)
        results <- run_model(model_type, N = current_N, beta = input$beta,
                             sigma = if (model_type == "SEIR") input$sigma else NULL,
                             gamma = if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) input$gamma else NULL,
                             days = input$days, init = init)
        ctx <- list(model_type = model_type, N = current_N, beta = input$beta,
                    sigma = if (model_type == "SEIR") input$sigma else NULL,
                    gamma = if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) input$gamma else NULL,
                    days = input$days, init = init,
                    start_date = min(results$Date), dataset = NULL,
                    simulation_only = TRUE, extra_days = 0, event = "default")
      } else {
        req(dataset())
        df <- dataset()
        extra <- max(0, input$extra_days %||% 0)

        obs_event <- input$obs_event %||% "default"
        results <- run_real_model(df, model_type, input$beta,
                                  sigma = if (model_type == "SEIR") input$sigma else NULL,
                                  gamma = if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) input$gamma else NULL,
                                  N = current_N, init = init, extra_days = extra,
                                  event = obs_event)
        win <- attr(results, "window")
        ctx <- list(model_type = model_type, N = current_N, beta = input$beta,
                    sigma = if (model_type == "SEIR") input$sigma else NULL,
                    gamma = if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) input$gamma else NULL,
                    days = length(win$dates) - 1, init = init,
                    start_date = win$start_date, dataset = df,
                    simulation_only = FALSE, extra_days = extra, event = obs_event)
      }

      incProgress(0.4, detail = "Finishing...")

      if (!is.null(results)) {
        model_results(results)
        current_model(model_type)
        simulation_only(sim_only)
        run_context(ctx)
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(
        paste("Error running model: Confirm that all parameters are properly set.", e$message),
        type = "error", duration = 10)
    })
  })
})

observeEvent(input$simulation_only, {
  previous_mode(simulation_only())
  simulation_only(input$simulation_only)
  run_clicked(FALSE)
  run_context(NULL)
  model_results(NULL)
  if (!input$simulation_only && is.null(input$file1)) {
    showNotification("Please upload a dataset when comparing with real data", type = "message", duration = 10)
  }
})

observeEvent(input$separate_plots, {
  separate_plots(input$separate_plots)
})

```


```{r get-demo-cols}
observe({
  req(dataset())
  df <- dataset()
  
  # get all column names
  all_cols <- names(df)
  
  # exclude unwanted columns like columns containing 'date' and columns named 'id' or 'x1'
  demo_cols <- all_cols[!grepl("date", all_cols, ignore.case = TRUE) & 
                        !tolower(all_cols) %in% c("id", "x1", "v1")]
  
  # update the selectize input
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "demo_vars", 
                      choices = sort(demo_cols),
                      selected = ifelse("sex" %in% demo_cols, "sex", demo_cols[1]))
})
```

### Model Visualization

```{r render-model-viz}

# NOTE: model_results / current_model / simulation_only / separate_plots are
# created once in the setup chunk. They used to be re-created here, which left
# two sets of reactive values in play and made the state depend on chunk order.

ci_settings <- reactive({
  list(
    ci_95 = isTRUE(input$ci_95),
    ci_90 = isTRUE(input$ci_90),
    ci_75 = isTRUE(input$ci_75),
    ci_50 = isTRUE(input$ci_50)
  )
})

any_ci_on <- reactive(any(unlist(ci_settings())))

# Confidence bands for the simulated scenario, in BOTH modules. Computed from
# the stored run context, so changing the CI level or the parameter CV does not
# require re-running the model - and nothing is computed until a band is asked
# for.
simulated_ci_r <- reactive({
  ctx <- run_context()
  req(ctx, any_ci_on())

  withProgress(message = "Computing confidence intervals...", value = 0.5, {
    tryCatch(
      simulate_ci(ctx$model_type, N = ctx$N, beta = ctx$beta,
                  sigma = ctx$sigma, gamma = ctx$gamma,
                  days = ctx$days, init = ctx$init, start_date = ctx$start_date,
                  n_draws = CI_N_DRAWS,
                  param_cv = input$param_cv %||% 0.10,
                  dataset = ctx$dataset),
      error = function(e) {
        showNotification(paste("Could not compute confidence intervals:", e$message),
                         type = "warning", duration = 10)
        NULL
      })
  })
})

# render combined plot
output$model_viz <- renderHighchart({
  req(model_results(), current_model(), !params_changed())

  results <- model_results()

  if (current_model() == "SI") {
    si_viz(results, separate = FALSE, simulation_only = simulation_only())
  } else if (current_model() == "SIR") {
    sir_viz(results, separate = FALSE, simulation_only = simulation_only())
  } else if (current_model() == "SEIR") {
    seir_viz(results, separate = FALSE, simulation_only = simulation_only())
  }
})

output$compartment_plot <- renderHighchart({
  req(model_results(), current_model(), input$separate_plots, input$compartment, !params_changed())

  compartment_viz(
    results = model_results(),
    compartment = input$compartment,
    simulation_only = simulation_only(),
    sim_ci = if (any_ci_on()) simulated_ci_r() else NULL,
    show_ci = ci_settings()
  )
})

# renderUI
renderUI({
  # Check if mode has changed by comparing current and previous simulation_only state
  mode_changed <- !is.null(previous_mode()) && previous_mode() != simulation_only()

  if (is.null(model_results()) || is.null(current_model()) || !run_clicked()) {
    if (mode_changed) {
      if (simulation_only()) {
        return(div(
          p("Welcome to Simulated Only mode! Adjust parameters and click 'Run Model Simulation' to visualize results.",
            style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
        ))
      } else {
        return(div(
          p("Welcome to Real vs Simulated mode! Upload a dataset, set the population at risk, adjust parameters, and click 'Run Model Simulation' to compare results.",
            style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
        ))
      }
    } else {
      return(div(
        p("Welcome to SEIRify! Choose 'Simulated Scenario Only' mode (toggle on) or 'Real vs. Simulated' mode (toggle off, upload a dataset). Pick a model, set parameters, and click 'Run Model Simulation' to see results.",
          style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
      ))
    }
  } else if (params_changed()) {
    return(div(
      p("Parameters updated. Click 'Run Model Simulation' to view new results.",
        style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
    ))
  }

  if (input$separate_plots) {
    div(
      style = "height: 450px; width: 100%;",
      highchartOutput("compartment_plot")
    )
  } else {
    highchartOutput("model_viz")
  }
})
```

### Comparison

```{r render-comparison-table}

output$comparison_table <- renderDT({
  req(run_clicked(), model_results(), current_model(), run_context(), !params_changed())
  ctx <- run_context()
  req(!ctx$simulation_only, !is.null(ctx$dataset))

  withProgress(message = "Comparing simulated and observed...", value = 0.5, {
    comp <- comparison_table_data(
      dataset = ctx$dataset, model_type = ctx$model_type,
      beta = ctx$beta, sigma = ctx$sigma, gamma = ctx$gamma,
      N = ctx$N, init = ctx$init, extra_days = ctx$extra_days,
      n_draws = CI_N_DRAWS, param_cv = input$param_cv %||% 0.10,
      event = ctx$event %||% "default")
  })

  datatable(
    comp,
    rownames = FALSE,
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    options = list(
      dom = 'Brt',
      buttons = c('csv','excel', 'pdf'),
      pageLength = nrow(comp),
      paging = FALSE,
      scrollY = "230px",
      scrollCollapse = TRUE,
      columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-right', targets = c(2, 3, 5)))
    )
  ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(comp),
      fontSize = '14px',
      fontFamily = APP_FONT
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(comp),
      target = 'row',
      borderBottom = '1px solid #ddd'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(comp),
      backgroundColor = 'white'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      'Metric',
      fontWeight = 'bold'
    )
})

renderUI({
  if (!run_clicked()) {
    p("...",
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
  } else if (params_changed()) {
    p("Parameters updated. Click 'Run Model Simulation' to view new results.",
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
  } else if (simulation_only()) {
    p("Comparison metrics are only available when comparing simulated and real scenarios.",
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
  } else {
    tagList(
      div(style = "font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 10px; color: #555;",
          "Observed values are counts from the uploaded line list and carry no interval. ",
          "The simulated column is the run shown in the chart, with a 95% interval from ",
          CI_N_DRAWS, " parameter draws. Difference = Observed - Simulated."),
      DTOutput("comparison_table")
    )
  }
})
```

```{r demo-analysis}
output$demographic_tables <- renderUI({
  req(input$demographics, !simulation_only(), input$demo_vars, dataset())
  
  df <- dataset() %>% 
    janitor::clean_names()

  
  tables <- lapply(input$demo_vars, function(var) {
    summary_df <- create_demographic_summary(df, var)
    tagList(
      h4(toupper(var), style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; fontWeight: bold;"),
      render_demographic_table(summary_df),
      br()
    )
  })
  
  tagList(tables)
})

renderUI({
  if (input$demographics && !simulation_only()) {
    uiOutput("demographic_tables")
  } else if (input$demographics && simulation_only()) {
    p("Demographics are only available when using real data.",
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
  } else {
    p("Demographics analysis is turned off. Toggle the switch in the sidebar to enable.", 
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT', 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
  }
})
```
